source_inspections.assessment: The Johnson projector acts on functions on a fixed subset homogeneous space and has a degree-two primitive eigenspace of dimension proportional to the Specht degree. The present projector acts on all functions on the full permutation group and projects onto a three-block matrix-coefficient space of dimension 1+(n-1)^2+d^2. It is not a covering theorem.

value.rationale: The full coefficient algebra of the 2-subset permutation representation is canonical. Its sharp absolute complementability constant is natural. The exact formula resolves every group order and exposes unexpectedly strict growing O(n) amplification over the dominant \(n(n-3)/2\)-dimensional block, with sharp \(\sqrt{\dim E_n}\) asymptotic \(3e^{-3/2}\), none implied by independent block norms.
